summary: The bad() method ignored the return value of FileInputStream.read(byte[]), which is CWE-252 (Unchecked Return Value). read() can return fewer bytes than requested or -1 at end-of-stream, so decoding the full buffer is incorrect. The fix captures the return value and uses the actual byte count to construct the String (and handles the end-of-stream case), preserving the file-reading feature while honoring the API contract.
